subjects.why: An attacker emptied Binance's hot wallets on ten blockchains in about four hours.
Three blockchain analytics firms count $6.36 billion to $6.43 billion taken, the largest crypto theft on record at the value when taken.
Customer withdrawals, and Binance's statement that it will cover every loss.
The analytics firms blame North Korea's TraderTraitor group; Binance and the US government have not confirmed who did it.
The transfers ran from hot wallets, including 50 pre-signed authorizations on Ethereum.
About $3 billion has been frozen so far.
Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty Financial froze about $2.67 billion in stablecoins.
The file's markets fact: Bitcoin at a six-week low of $76,368.
Ten claims spread across platforms; each is checked against its sources in the file.
